reason: The Ask PAGE is capped at 'width: min(100%, 760px)' (globals.css .ask-panel[data-surface="page"]), so on a normal desktop window it sits as a narrow centred column with large empty gutters either side, while every other page fills the shell. The surface is table-heavy - 67 GL-code rows, 81 statement-leaf rows whose keys are long composite strings - so the cap actively hurts the content it holds. Widen the page surface; the 360px docked surface is unaffected.
